metric_definitions.ammo_available_fraction: Fraction of simulated time the color is loaded or next; it does not imply chain geometry.
metric_definitions.fresh_counts: Weighted-run generator output only; excludes the fixed 12-ball starter preset.
metric_definitions.match_opportunity: A visible adjacent same-color pair within 1.25 spacing: a launch-time proxy, not a guaranteed hit or match.
metric_definitions.shot_trajectory: The bot freezes current target X at launch; after exactly 0.20s of chain movement, actual try_insert_shot collision runs only at that immutable X.
metric_definitions.starved_threat: Enemy estimated <=10s from defender while pair+ammo+ready timing are not all simultaneously available.
metric_definitions.visible_mean: Time-weighted mean circles intersecting [0,lane_width]; off-left/right history is unavailable.
